meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成首次设置,跑通核心流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到 omo,不知道第一步该做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Finish first-time setup and run through the core workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just got omo and don't know the first step.

howto.what: 新用户第一次对话时,它充当向导,依次走六个环节:功能介绍、从其他编码助手迁移配置、翻看你过去的会话、用真实用量估算缓存能省多少、全程随时把持久事实写入记忆,以及首个 init-deep 建议。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想开始用 omo 时自动启动,且只自动跑一次;之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 手动唤回。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo,带我过一遍。
我以前用 Claude Code,帮我把配置迁移过来。
say.note: 它读旧配置给出方案,等你确认才应用。

say.text: 看看我过去的编码会话,估算一下缓存能省多少。
say.note: 用本地会话日志算出估算值。

howto.what_en: On a new user's first conversation it guides them through a feature tour, migration from another coding agent, past-session review, a cache-savings estimate from real usage, memory recording, and a first init-deep proposal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo; it auto-starts only once, and can be recalled later with the `senpi --onboard` flag.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo - walk me through getting started.
I used to work with Claude Code; migrate my setup.
say_en.note: It reads old config, shows a plan, waits for your OK.

say_en.text: Look through my past coding sessions and estimate cache savings.
say_en.note: It computes an estimate from local session logs.
